scoring_justification: T1 recompute: barrier reduction recomputed from raw MEP arrays with threshold_or_better on 0.5 eV reduction derived from paper's reported ~1 eV lower barrier.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure 10a states Al lowers the C_i-V_C pair formation barrier by ~1 eV. The threshold of 0.5 eV is a conservative lower bound that rewards any positive reduction.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's reported ~1 eV lowering; set to 0.5 eV to give credit for moderate reductions while requiring at least 0.5 eV to reach full credit.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly derived from the paper-reported barrier lowering (approx. 1 eV) and used only as a monotonic threshold; not an arbitrary number.

schema.description: Array of 7 relative total energies (in eV) for the CI-NEB images of C_i-V_C formation in pure 4H-SiC. The first and last energies correspond to the initial and final states.

outputs.description: Minimum energy path (MEP) energies for the C_i-V_C Frenkel pair formation in pure 4H-SiC, obtained from a CI-NEB calculation with 7 images.

schema.description: Array of 7 relative total energies (in eV) for the CI-NEB images of C_i-V_C formation in the Al_Si-doped 4H-SiC supercell.

outputs.description: Minimum energy path (MEP) energies for the C_i-V_C Frenkel pair formation in the presence of an Al_Si substitution, from a CI-NEB calculation with 7 images.

output_contract.notes: The checker recomputes the energy barrier (maximum minus minimum) from each MEP array and evaluates the reduction caused by Al doping using a threshold_or_better policy. The agent must provide exactly 7 energies per file in correct order.

steps.description: Recompute barriers from both MEP arrays, compute reduction = barrier_pure - barrier_al, score threshold_or_better with threshold 0.5 eV. Full credit if reduction >= 0.5 eV, partial credit proportional to reduction/0.5 (capped at 1.0) otherwise.
Check that mep_with_al.json is a JSON array of exactly 7 numbers. Score 1 if valid, 0 otherwise.
